policy: A strategy is PAPER until it passes promotion checks, then LIVE, and can be sent back to PAPER by a demotion gate. Staking metrics never promote a strategy; a lucky ROI run alone cannot keep a bad signal live.
status: PROPOSED design - thresholds are proposals from this project, not an official standard; the CLV-side gate and its tests live in price-store/scripts/gates.py (parallel session).

promotion.rule: All ten committed validation gates pass (10/10).
G9 (executable pricing) verified against a real, licensed source.
Price-snapshot feed active so closing-line value can be measured.

demotion.rule: n_live >= 200 settled bets AND one-sided 95% upper bound of mean CLV < 0 -> DEMOTE_TO_PAPER.
demotion.input: closing-line value from the price-snapshot store

demotion.rule: n_live >= 200 settled bets AND one-sided 95% upper bound of mean per-bet ROI < 0 -> DEMOTE_TO_PAPER.
